_readme: Real buyer reviews only — copy them verbatim from the Etsy shop reviews page, with the reviewer's Etsy display name. Never write these yourself: they are shown as genuine customer words and the site also declares them to Google. An empty list hides the whole section, which is the safe default.

reviews.author: Anni
reviews.text: The bag has a nice print and the zipper works smoothly. The size is practical for small gifts or a travel first-aid kit. I'm very satisfied.

reviews.author: Anni
reviews.text: I'm very happy with my purchase. It's a practical size for small items and the print quality is good. There was a minor shipping issue, but the seller took care of it immediately.

reviews.author: Merel
reviews.text: Very happy with the item, exactly like being shown. Delivery was quick and smooth. The seller is super friendly and really helpful!
